units.function: A 1,675-line CLI integration specification for creating, initializing, seeding, reseeding and repairing isolated Git worktree instances, including configuration/ports/storage/database/Secret/auth cloning, execution quarantine, workspace rebinding, Git hooks and rollback.
units.dependencyDirection: The suite directly composes Node filesystem/process/network/Git, first-party database tables, embedded PostgreSQL, deployment config and many worktree command helpers. It crosses deployment, identity, Secret, database, execution, scheduling, storage and repository boundaries in one operational subsystem.
units.keyDataModels: Worktree instance/home/config/env paths and branding; source/target database/ports/backups/storage; seed plans/markers/locks; Agent runtime/heartbeat, Work assignments/locks/status, users; Secret master/JWT keys; Project workspaces/cwd; Routines/triggers; attachments and Git hooks/branches.
units.lifecycle: Discover repository-local target; sanitize instance/branch and allocate ports; create Git worktree; derive isolated config/env; optionally copy database, users, Secret keys and signing key; quarantine live Agent/Work/scheduled state; rebind workspace paths; mark seed completion under a lock; reseed with backup/rollback; repair missing metadata or branch worktree; mirror hooks.
units.testAssessment: The elevated focused run on 2026-08-19 produced 37 passed, 2 failed and 4 skipped out of 43; CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. The remaining failures are macOS logical `/var/...` versus canonical `/private/var/...` path assertions. Four embedded-PostgreSQL tests were skipped because startup failed after five attempts even outside the sandbox. The default sandbox run additionally caused six local-port tests to exhaust probing to 65536, confirming an unbounded-port failure path under denied/unavailable sockets. Source coverage is complete but runtime verification is not fully green.
units.designRationale: Make parallel development worktrees behave as independent Paperclip instances while retaining enough production-like data/configuration for debugging, and aggressively quarantine copied live execution/scheduling state to prevent duplicate automation.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe FDE staging, Demo/template sandboxes, migration rehearsals and self-hosted recovery environments that can clone selected organizational/data state without cloning production identity, Secrets, sessions or live execution authority.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT the subsystem around explicit EnvironmentClone/Application workflows and deployment-node ports. ADAPT seed marker/fencing, fail-closed source selection, previewable minimal/full plans, execution/schedule quarantine, path rebinding, non-destructive checkout preservation and reseed rollback. Replace trust-domain cloning with sanitized data export, synthetic or re-enrolled principals, new issuer/audience/signing/encryption keys, Secret rebind contracts, immutable provenance and operator-approved receipts.
units.responsibilityConflict: Copied Work and users retain organizational state while Agent assignments/locks are cleared and recorded mostly by a comment; copied auth/Secret/JWT keys allow the branch to impersonate source identities and decrypt source material. A Company OS clone must preserve historical responsibility as source provenance while denying all inherited execution/identity authority until explicitly re-bound by an accountable human.

securityFindings: Critical adoption blocker: source local-encrypted master keys, inline master keys and Agent JWT signing Secrets are copied verbatim into the worktree, cloning decryption and token-issuance authority.
Authenticated user rows are cloned into the branch; combined with copied signing/encryption keys this can preserve production-like identity and personal data beyond the intended environment boundary.
Execution quarantine clears Agent assignments/locks but must retain prior executor/Run/contract as immutable provenance; a free-text quarantine comment is insufficient responsibility evidence.

Git hooks are copied executable from the source repository into linked worktrees, transferring arbitrary code and auxiliary token lists without tested signature/ownership/allowlist or untrusted-checkout policy.

Port search can increment through 65536 when all probes fail/are denied, yielding RangeError instead of a bounded stable error; elevated execution showed the ordinary path works but not the exhaustion case.

Path identity is inconsistent on macOS `/var` symlinks: implementation returns canonical `/private/var` while tests compare logical paths. Cleanup, authorization and equality checks need one explicit canonical-path contract.
Embedded PostgreSQL integration remains unverified on this host; database clone/quarantine/user/schedule behavior cannot be claimed runtime-green from source inspection alone.

Minimal seed drops Run/event/session history and nulls execution references; useful for size/safety, but historical responsibility/evidence retention needs an explicit manifest rather than silent omission.
Attachment fallback returns null when every backing store misses the object; missing evidence must fail integrity validation or be explicitly approved and recorded.
Reseed rollback is tested for an early invalid-source failure but not crash/power-loss, partial database restore, rollback failure, concurrent service access or irreversible external side effects.
Repair may remove stale instance data before recreating metadata, so exact-target preview, recoverable backup, symlink defenses and durable operator receipts are required.
Direct database quarantine/pause operations bypass ordinary service authorization/events and must be restricted to separately governed break-glass tooling.
